primary_references.title: Dimensions, chapters 3 and 4: The fourth dimension
facts: Describes 4D points as four coordinates; gives tesseract counts 16 vertices, 32 edges, 24 squares, 8 cubes; contrasts moving 3D sections and 3D shadows; describes 4D stereographic projection and the projection-pole blow-up.
primary_references.use: Primary design reference for separate shadow, slice, and stereographic experiments.

primary_references.title: Niles Johnson, A visualization of the Hopf fibration
facts: Describes circles over S2 points, pairwise linked fibers, latitude tori, two solid tori joined at an equatorial torus, and the apparent line/circle through infinity.
primary_references.use: Primary visual and explanatory reference for sampled fibers, links, and pole handling.

primary_references.title: David W. Lyons, An Elementary Introduction to the Hopf Fibration
facts: Defines a Hopf map S3 to S2; gives a stereographic map S3 minus one point to R3; explains circle fibers, exceptional line at the projection point, and linked projected fibers.
primary_references.use: Primary derivation reference; record coordinate/sign convention when implementing the complex-pair form.

research_gaps: No independent upstream execution or test rerun in Gate 0.
No source-to-deployment commit association for the live Vercel page.
No deterministic run/replay library or immutable evidence contract in inspected sources.
No evidence that semantic abacus state or thresholds improve human understanding or coordination.
Finite sampled fibers and stereographic clipping require an explicit pole/infinity policy.

companion_decision.reason: Interfractal couples camera motion, source-like spins, staged bloom, clipping, nested shells, and narrative state; a small companion can freeze the model and display-camera variables and record deterministic replay while reusing proven visual and nonclaim patterns.
companion_decision.future_scope: Gate 0 ordinary cube probe only; 4D/5D hypercubes, solid-ball slices, Hopf correspondence, and candidate shared-reference mapping wait for later approved gates.
